commands.name: readiness
command: import json;from pathlib import Path;from pixl.readiness import verify_manifest;print(json.dumps(verify_manifest(Path('plugins/pixl').resolve()),indent=2))

readiness.meaning: Listed payload bytes match this local manifest; publisher authenticity and host loading are not established.

scope: Four local packaging tests, manifest readiness, and skill discovery routes. Bundle builder writes are expected; before/after hashes identify any actual byte changes. Synthetic provider/family probes do not execute remote tools or establish artwork, native host, or engine acceptance.
